shared.description: Settings merged into every stage. The addon's `namespace` belongs here, and so does `pretty`, which lays out every file the stack generates. A stage that does not read a key ignores it.

namespace.description: The addon's namespace, `<creator>_<pack>`, when the stages should not read it off the `core.register()` call.

pretty.description: How generated JSON is laid out. Absent or false writes it minified. An object lays it out: `indent` is "tab" or "space" (spaces when omitted), `size` the characters per level (2 for spaces, 1 for tabs when omitted).

generator.description: The generator runs only when this key is present — it writes schema types into the project, so a project opts in. `true` runs it with its defaults.

stage.description: Settings for this stage, merged over `shared`. `false` skips the stage.
